_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil compresses further with crushed volatility (DVOL 29th pct), tight liquidity, and stretched long positioning — the base rate says score holds at ±2 in 73 of 73 windows, so HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until volume or flows confirm the breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both agree on HOLD direction and a coiling Denial phase, but the analyst forward-calls Disbelief (one rung up) with medium conviction while the Narrative implies accumulation toward Hope without explicit phase-call; the analyst's self-doubt (0-for-10) tempers any agreement.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks $65K with volume expansion + ETF flows rising above 50 + funding cooling below 0.005% (short squeeze fuel), OR BTC breaks below $60K with VIX spike above 80 + exchange netflow flipping strongly positive (forced selling)
next_move.invalidated_if: Score drifts to 62+ (Hope) without volume/flow confirmation — fake breakout to trap longs; OR score drops to 54- (Complacency) with no macro catalyst — grind lower on liquidity drain
